music_directories.description: Every audio directory or audio-file path listed here becomes a live library source. Non-empty sources automatically appear as tabs named from the final folder or file path component. Edit this array directly; the mod detects and hot reloads changes without a button.

ui_mode.description: 0 = Follow System, 1 = Dark Mode, 2 = Light Mode.

loop_mode.description: 0 = off, 1 = loop all tracks in the current tab, 2 = loop one.

online_enabled.description: Enables online search and playback (YouTube search results, direct http(s) stream URLs). Type a search and press Enter when there is no local match, or on the Online tab; paste an http(s) audio URL to stream it.

ui_panel_x.description: Auto-saved panel X position in screen pixels.

ui_panel_y.description: Auto-saved panel Y position in screen pixels.

ui_panel_position_saved.description: True after the panel has a persisted position.

ui_sort_mode.description: Auto-saved library sort mode: 0 custom/scan order, 1 title A-Z, 2 artist A-Z.

ui_active_playlist.description: Auto-saved active playlist/folder path. Empty means All.
